title: CEO of finance giant Pimco: 'Markets are sending France a serious signal. The situation is grave'

title: French wine grape harvest set to hit historic low
subhead: According to Agriculture Ministry estimates, France's total 2026 wine harvest is predicted to reach some 35 million hectolitres, down 14% on the 2021-2025 average, after several summer heatwaves and declining cultivated areas.
